card.name: "of" in dual RAS blockade warning
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "increased risk(s)" in the warning about dual blockade of the renin-angiotensin system with ARBs, ACE inhibitors, or aliskiren. It also fires weakly on "cause" in the fetal-injury warning for drugs acting on the renin-angiotensin system.

modes.label: Risk of after dual blockade
modes.description: "of" following "increased risk" or "risks" in the dual RAS blockade sentence, just before hypotension and hyperkalemia.
modes.example: (RAS) Dual blockade of the RAS with angiotensin receptor blockers, ACE inhibitors, or aliskiren is associated with increased risk<< of>> hypotension, hyperkalemia

modes.label: Fetal injury warning
modes.description: "cause" after "drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can", before injury and death to the fetus.
modes.example: as possible. ( 5.1 , 8.1 ) • Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can<< cause>> injury and death to the developing fetus [
